'''Code DENA-1101-22-6''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] code that allowed [[Transport/Legends|transports]] from [[Camura Lines]] and [[Entea Corporation]] access to the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]] after it was closed to civilian traffic.
